subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should OpenClaw's recommended active memory path move durable canonical memory from Markdown/plugin-specific stores into a typed SQLite record model for memory-core v1?
rationale: This is not a broken existing behavior report; it is a persistent data-model and owner-boundary choice that overlaps current Markdown memory, memory-wiki claims, memory-lancedb records, and the memory plugin slot.

options.title: Sponsor the SQLite schema design
options.body: Keep this issue open as the schema/design anchor, define the minimal v1 record model and migration boundary, then implement it in the chosen memory owner.

options.title: Route typed records to a plugin
options.body: Keep memory-core Markdown/index behavior stable and ask typed canonical records to live in memory-wiki, memory-lancedb, or another memory plugin unless a missing SDK seam appears.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decide that current Markdown plus search-index storage remains the durable memory model and close this schema direction with that rationale.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the SQLite schema design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the schema/design anchor, define the minimal v1 record model and migration boundary, then implement it in the chosen memory owner.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory schema, SDK, docs, and memory-core refactor history make this the strongest routing candidate for the product/schema call.
